requirements: Reconcile live fork and contributor heads, existing claims, prior narrow gate receipt and release before claim. Do not overlap another recovery worker.

Build a controlled test-only SolrCloud probe on the exact production head with a real leader and NRT replica. Existing HttpPartitionTest is a reference for terms and recovery, not proof of a queued stall; TlogLeaderElectionFrozenLeaderTest shows a controlled Jetty filter. Identify exact overlay files and keep production unchanged for comparison.

Demonstrate the leader-to-replica update request is blocked and at least one older update remains queued when the real stall detector raises its IOException. Capture direct evidence of those preconditions and the node-specific error; a socket timeout, ordinary partition, empty queue or merely stalled servlet is not sufficient.

Observe the update request outcome and actual shard terms or leadership eligibility before recovery, then release the fault and verify recovery to ACTIVE and document IDs/versions on leader and replica. Keep fault control bounded and always release it in cleanup. Record any unsuccessful reproduction or unexpected effects without implying recovery succeeded.

Where feasible compare a test-only equivalent on pinned contributor head eedcb534aca361be5bad5c56f1b2d3002eea855f and base 0ea013e782f747cc94e1504f8077f813d2ddcca8; distinguish the original error-loss premise from the separate ordering fix. A non-reproduction or harness failure is not fail-before proof.

If this becomes a deterministic maintainable permanent test, commit it on a new descriptive branch of the fork based on 6bf469128d2dd570336ff634e41c07012d918d31, without PR identifiers in branch or commit messages, push without force, verify the remote head, and publish a successor gate requiring repeated focused real-cluster execution, no skipped tests, tidy and root check -x test -Prefguide.include=false. Preserve the existing narrow branch. Do not report the overlay probe as proof of a newly committed head.

File receipt and evidence with precise commands, assertions, observed preconditions, test counts, skips, failure and timing details, source heads, cleanup and stop evidence; release. No public comments.
verdict_policy: Pass for this investigative gate requires demonstrated actual queued stall and observed error propagation, term or leadership eligibility change, successful recovery and document-state assertions. Otherwise report incomplete, failed or non-reproduced as appropriate; do not claim production recovery proof.
